answer: The cost of the n-th identity from one zephyr cluster grows exponentially: identity k costs 100·2^k POA. An attacker's 10 fakes therefore cost roughly 10000 POA, with the 2x factor making mass farming prohibitive. A knoll link-analysis pass groups identities by funding wallet and device fingerprint, and the glacier ledger requires each new member to satisfy an escalating bond — so the marginal sybil always loses money.
